title: Product Sense Cases
sub: Diagnose, decide, and prioritize like a PM.

cards.scenario: A ride-sharing app sees weekend rides drop 20% in one city over three weeks. No product changes shipped in that period.
cards.question: How would you diagnose the root cause?
answer: Confirm the data pipeline and metric definition are intact first
Segment: riders vs drivers, new vs returning, time-of-day
Check external factors — weather, local events, competitor promos
Walk the funnel week-over-week to isolate the drop-off stage

cards.scenario: Leadership wants to add a social feed to a productivity app to boost engagement.
cards.question: Would you build it? How do you decide?
answer: Clarify the goal behind “engagement” — retention or session time?
Assess fit with core job-to-be-done, risk of distraction
Propose a cheap test before committing eng resources
Define success metrics and a kill criterion up front

cards.scenario: A checkout flow converts at 55% on desktop but only 30% on mobile.
cards.question: Where do you focus to close the gap?
answer: Instrument each mobile step to find the biggest drop
Audit form length, autofill, and payment options on mobile
Test one high-leverage fix, measure lift
Watch session replays for friction the funnel hides
